funding_types.quote: (Loans are repayable with competitive interest rates and repayment terms).

max_amount.text: Up to $150,000 per applicant (more in some cases)
max_amount.quote: The CBDC offers loans of up to $150,000* per eligible applicant.

criteria.text: Operations in rural Atlantic Canada (which includes Newfoundland and Labrador)
criteria.quote: The Social Enterprise and its operations must be located in rural areas of Atlantic Canada;

criteria.text: A non-profit (including charities and societies) or a co-operative
criteria.quote: CBDC Social Enterprise Loans and financing is available to non-profits, including charities, cooperatives or societies in need of business support (in the form of a loan or loan guarantee).

criteria.text: The social enterprise and its operations are in rural areas
criteria.quote: The Social Enterprise and its operations must be located in rural areas of Atlantic Canada;

criteria.text: The loan supports revenue-generating business operations of a registered non-profit
criteria.quote: CBDC Social Enterprise Loans are specifically intended to provide financial support for revenue generating business operations of officially registered non-profit organizations.

criteria.text: The business activity has a reasonable expectation of economic viability
criteria.quote: The Social Enterprise’s business activity should demonstrate a reasonable expectation of economic viability

criteria.text: Your local CBDC offers this loan (programs vary by region)
criteria.quote: Programs and services delivered by CBDCs may vary by region.

research.notes: Structure: non-profits (including charities and societies) and co-operatives; sole proprietors, partnerships, corporations and businesses not yet registered miss. The page says CBDCs may exceed $150,000 in certain instances. Intake: not stated. Contacts: the offices of CBDC Central (Grand Falls-Windsor), CBDC Gander Area and CBDC Emerald (Baie Verte, with a Springdale satellite office), each quoted from its own cbdc.ca office page saved as a source of this record; all three pages list this loan. Only the Gander Area page names the places it serves (a list of place names, not census divisions), so census_divisions is null for every office and there is no location rule beyond the province (contract question B). Other CBDCs in the province are not listed as contacts. Office labels name the office and its town only, every word of which is in the contact's own quote (DECISIONS #25); the app's line above several contacts tells an owner to call the office nearest them.
